text:
maya: Heads-up — we have a cross-repo dependency to merge today. SDK PR repo/sdk#412 updates the client API (minor breaking: field rename) and console repo/console#189 depends on it. Helm charts repo/charts#221 needs the new image tag. Can reviewers please coordinate? We should avoid merging console before SDK and bumping helm at the same time.

aj: I can take sdk#412 review now. Quick Q — is the field rename backward-compatible if callers use the old field?

maya: @aj short answer: not fully. We added a compatibility shim but it'll log a warning and is removed in the next major. We need a rollout plan: console should pin to sdk v1.3.0-rc and we do a canary.

sara: I'll update CI gating for console to require sdk artifact presence. Which artifact name/tag do we expect?

maya: artifact tag is redwood/sdk:v1.3.0-rc (image + pypi wheel). console PR includes a temporary lock in package.json and an image override in values.yml.

aj: starting code review now. Expect comments in ~30m.

tariq: I can hold the merge queue if reviews land early — want to avoid auto-merge that races with helm PR. Who can flip the hold?

jen: I can toggle the hold on the merge queue. Will wait until both sdk and console are approved. Please ping me when both are green.

ci-bot: [ci] sdk#412 — tests: 13/14 passed (flake: test_kv_cache). Full run queued.

aj: left two small comments about docs and the shim test. Nothing blocking.

maya: thanks. @aj can you re-run the flake locally? test_kv_cache flakes in gpu env sometimes.

aj: yep repro'd locally, pushing a flaky guard now.

ci-bot: [ci] sdk#412 — all checks passed.

tariq: sdk merged. I held the merge queue earlier, releasing now?

jen: please hold — console still needs one approval (sara). I'll flip the hold once console is merged and helm tag PR is open.

sara: reviewing console#189 now. Small UX nit, approving after update.

sara: approved.

jen: thanks. Holding lifted. Merge queue: ON.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled: console:canary -> infra-staging at 1760865200. Will monitor 15m.

maya: after canary looks good, we'll merge charts#221 to point to redwood/sdk:v1.3.0 and promote image to prod. Any objections to a 30m monitoring window?

aj: fine by me.

jen: 30m sgtm. I'll watch the merge queue and rollback steps ready.

maya: great — thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a post-merge note listing the callers that need to switch fields and a reminder about the next major removal of the shim. :thumbsup:
